name: What permits are required for structural wall framing in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for structural wall framing in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: For any project involving new structural wall framing, significant modifications to existing framing, or additions that change the structural footprint, you will almost certainly need a building permit from the City of Daly City's building department. This includes ensuring compliance with local zoning ordinances, seismic requirements, and all applicable building codes. A licensed general contractor will typically manage the permit application process, including submitting plans and facilitating inspections, to ensure all work is approved and up to standard.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building permits are required from Daly City for new structural framing or significant modifications. A licensed contractor typically manages this process.
